name: weixin_split_markdown_blocks
notes: Markdown block splitting for WeChat delivery (code fences, paragraph breaks, empty-block filtering). Traced copy of src/gateway/platforms/weixin.c::weixin_split_markdown_blocks vs LIVE gateway/platforms/weixin.py::_split_markdown_blocks. Cup value encodes block count + \x1f-joined blocks so content is parity-checked too. Inputs avoid two documented C/LIVE edge divergences: (1) LIVE rstrips each line while C only strips CR, so mid-block trailing whitespace differs; (2) a fence-like line containing an embedded backtick after ``` matches C's strncmp prefix test but fails LIVE's ^```[^`]*$ regex.
